title: A familiar rule becomes truly clear

captions.energy: Understanding the meaning of established knowledge

meaning: Established knowledge can bring the pleasure of clarity when familiar words acquire a meaning both of you genuinely understand.
text: A rule can be familiar long before it becomes understandable. The Hierophant in the physical position of Ajna suggests discussing learned principles and examining their application. The Hierophant in energy supports respect for knowledge and a wish to grasp its meaning. The Sun in emotions enjoys clarity. Your actions consult a common language while your motive seeks to understand it.

For example, you read about writing a short story and return to “show rather than tell”. Discussing one paragraph reveals a difference between naming a feeling and a scene that makes it visible. **A familiar principle becomes clear through an example you both understand.** Particular versions of the text now have a concrete basis for comparison. The learned phrase stops sounding like a mysterious demand. You see what it helps reveal while retaining interest in other ways of telling a story where the same advice still needs fresh understanding.

The risk is expecting every subsequent difficulty to yield to the same principle because clarity felt so pleasing. The words already sound persuasive and repetition seems sufficient. Wanting a deeper grasp of knowledge leaves room for the conditions of its application. Another paragraph may need another distinction. Pleasure in the answer can survive acknowledging that it clarified one case while further inquiry retains questions of its own.
